name: 哈德温
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_一_崛起上.md:759
who: Hadwin, a human man of forty-four, the gate-keeper's son of the Waiting Gate valley, a leader of the valley folk: tall, about 186 cm, broad and deep through the back from carrying people, a heavy-shouldered, square-framed build. Short-cut deep blue hair, the temples long since white. A square face like his father's, pale amber eyes that seem to hold a little light when seen by firelight. Palms and fingers thickly callused from spear and carrying straps. A calm, patient, immovable air. No glasses, no jewelry apart from one plain pale silver ring.
build: 186 cm, tall and broad: a thick deep back, wide shoulders, heavy forearms, a solid frame that can carry a person all day without changing shoulders.
palette: worn copper-bronze and deep blue, iron grey, pale silver, faint amber
casual: His old Blackstone gate-guard armour: a breastplate of copper-colored pressed hide plates, polished smooth, with a seven-ringed wall branded on the chest worn down until only three rings remain, a coarse grey wool tunic under it, leather bracers, worn boots; his belt is empty, no keys. He holds his father's very long spear upright in his right hand, longer than a horse. A pale silver ring on his left hand (on the viewer's right when they face us). A calm, steady look.
private: Off duty: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a sleeveless brown leather jerkin open at the front, plain wool trousers, soft old boots, no armour. He stands with his arms folded loosely, the pale silver ring on his left hand (on the viewer's right when they face us); a quiet, tired half-smile.
battle: Ready to hold a line: the copper-hide breastplate with the worn three-ring brand, copper-hide shoulder guards, leather gauntlets, a heavy grey wool cloak fastened at the throat. He grips the very long spear in both hands, levelled forward, feet planted wide. A hard, calm look, the mouth shut.
formal: For the valley's oath: the copper-hide armour freshly brushed with its worn three-ring wall brand, a grey wool tunic with a soft folded collar under it, a long deep blue wool cloak pinned at the shoulder with a small bronze pin, the spear held upright beside him with a thin thread of cold light running along its socket. Shoulders back and head high; a grave, gentle look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the pale amber eyes looking at the viewer with a steady, patient look, lips closed. Warm orange firelight from one side catching the amber of his eyes, cold blue snow-night on the other. Foreground blur: drifting snowflakes and the blurred iron head of a spear. He wears the old copper-hide armour with the worn brand.

name: 梅瑞丝
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_一_崛起上.md:815
who: Meirece, a human woman who looks thirty-six and always will: tall, about 172 cm, thin, her back straight as if measured with a rule. Straight jaw-length black hair cut in a blunt line with a blue-black sheen like a raven's feather, one lock always falling across her forehead. A pale, still face, violet eyes that look at people as if counting them. A pale silver ring engraved inside with her name on the middle finger of her right hand (on the viewer's left when they face us); the fingertips of her left hand (on the viewer's right) are permanently stained black with ink. A cold, precise, patient air. Her hair is dead straight and smooth, every strand hanging straight down, cut in one blunt horizontal line at the jaw, with no waves, no curls and no feathered layers; only one straight lock falls across her forehead, drawn the same in every panel.
build: 172 cm, slender and very straight: narrow shoulders, a small B-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips, long thin hands.
palette: academy wool grey, ink black, pale silver, violet
casual: Her academy robe: a long plain grey wool robe with the sleeve cuffs rubbed shiny, closed down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a black cord tied at the waist with a rolled scroll of ring diagrams hanging from it; plain dark boots. No staff. She holds her right hand slightly raised so the pale silver ring shows. A calm, counting look.
private: Her quiet hours: the same grey wool but a softer, older robe with the sleeves pushed up, the black cord loose, no scroll, soft flat shoes. She holds a small bundle of ink-stained pages against her chest with her left arm; a tired, absent look.
battle: Standing as the centre of a ring: the grey robe with the sleeves tied back, the black cord drawn tight, the scroll of ring diagrams unrolled in her left hand. Her right hand is held out flat in front of her, palm down, the pale silver ring glinting. No weapon. A cold, focused look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: straight and still, the feet together, the right hand held out flat in front of her with the pale silver ring showing, the scroll of ring diagrams unrolled in the left hand; she carries no weapon and does not smile.
formal: The academy's formal dress: the grey wool robe freshly brushed, the cuffs clean, the pale silver ring on her right middle finger, the black cord replaced by a neat black sash, the scroll left off. She stands very straight with her hands folded in front; a grave, exact look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the violet eyes looking at the viewer as if counting, lips closed. Cold white light from one side, a thin cold blue shadow on the other. Foreground blur: pale silver rings drifting in the air, a fall of snow, the edge of a rolled diagram. She wears the grey academy robe closed to the throat, the lock of hair across her forehead.

name: 海德薇
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_一_崛起上.md:869
who: Hedwig, a human woman of twenty-seven, the last heavy cavalry rider of the Blackstone highlands: tall, about 178 cm, strong, with the thick shoulders and back of a rider. A thick pale-gold braid coiled at the back of her head, falling to her waist when unpinned. Cheeks reddened by highland wind, a thin scar across the bridge of her nose from a copper-wolf's claw. Blue eyes that narrow when she looks into the distance. The knuckles of her left hand (on the viewer's right when they face us) are bent out of shape from gripping reins. A blunt, proud, stubborn air. No glasses, no earrings.
build: 178 cm, tall and strong: broad rider's shoulders and back, a C-cup, a firm waist, long strong legs and full hips.
palette: copper-bronze and pale silver, pale gold, wind red, highland blue
casual: Her Blackstone heavy cavalry armour: a breastplate and shoulder guards of copper-colored pressed hide with pale silver dust mixed in so the plates flash cold, a seven-ringed wall branded on the chest with the innermost ring scraped away by a knife, a grey wool tunic and leather riding trousers under it, tall riding boots. She holds a long cavalry lance upright in her right hand and her helmet under her left arm. A blunt, proud look.
private: Off duty: a thick undyed wool shirt with a loose open collar, the sleeves rolled, a brown leather vest, plain wool trousers and soft boots, the braid unpinned and hanging over one shoulder. She holds her arms folded loosely; a rare small smile.
battle: Ready to charge: the copper-hide armour with the scraped brand, a copper-hide cloak flung back from her shoulders, leather gauntlets, the helmet on her head with the visor up. She grips the long lance in both hands, levelled forward, the feet planted wide. A fierce, determined look.
formal: For the highland muster: the armour polished bright, a clean undyed wool surcoat over the cuirass belted with bronze, a long deep blue cloak pinned at the shoulder, the braid coiled neatly at the back of her head, the helmet under her arm. She stands tall and straight; a stern, dignified look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the blue eyes narrowed a little as if looking into the far distance, lips closed. Cold glare of snow light from one side and a warm bronze glint on the armour from the other. Foreground blur: drifting snow and the point of a lance. She wears the copper-hide armour, the thin scar across her nose clear.

name: 莉瑟
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_一_崛起上.md:925
who: Lise, a human girl of nine, a thin small child of the Waiting Gate valley who counts the gates: about 128 cm, small and thin, wholly covered by her clothes. Straw-coloured hair she has hacked off herself with a stone, ragged and uneven. A face reddened with chilblains, large very pale blue eyes that look at people while her lips move in a quiet count. On the thumb of her right hand (on the viewer's left when they face us) a chunky ring of pale carved wood, like a small wooden curtain ring, worn loose around the thumb itself. A serious, watchful, stubborn little air. Her wrists are bare: both sleeves end at plain bare wrists with no rope, cord, twine, string, bracelet or band of any kind around either wrist or hand, in every panel; the only thing she wears on her hands is that one wooden thumb ring.
palette: straw yellow and frost blue, faded brown wool, wood brown, snow white
casual: Her clothes: a short coat cut down from a grown-up's old coat, the sleeves rolled up three times, buttoned to the throat, over a long-sleeved wool dress and thick stockings, patched boots wrapped with rag. She holds up three fingers of her left hand, counting, and her right hand (on the viewer's left when they face us) is raised beside it with the thumb stuck up, so the chunky pale wooden ring around that thumb shows plainly; both wrists bare; a serious look.
private: Home clothes: a long-sleeved, high-necked grey wool dress to the ankles under a worn knitted shawl, thick stockings, soft shoes, the ragged hair loose. She clutches the ends of the shawl; a sleepy, closed-mouth look.
battle: Braced for the night of the ring: the short coat buttoned to the chin, a wool scarf wound up over her chin, fingerless wool mittens, boots laced tight; she carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the night-of-the-ring outfit: standing straight and braced, the feet planted a little apart, one hand raised with the fingers spread as if counting, a serious firm expression; she carries no weapon.
formal: For the valley's night of oath: a clean long-sleeved dark wool dress with a white collar, her hair combed flat as well as it will go, the wooden ring on her right thumb (on the viewer's left when they face us). She stands upright with her hands folded in front, the right hand on top with its thumb and the wooden ring showing, both wrists bare; a solemn little look.
art: A close head-and-shoulders portrait, the large pale blue eyes looking at the viewer seriously, mouth closed as if counting silently. Cold blue snow-light from one side and a small warm firelight from the other. Foreground blur: falling snowflakes. She wears the short coat with the rolled sleeves.
art_extra: The light is cold blue-white snow-light on one side and a small warm orange firelight on the other, with drifting white snowflakes in the foreground: no petals, leaves or blossoms, and no pink or magenta light anywhere; her hair stays plain straw-blonde under both lights.

name: 埃利奥
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_一_崛起上.md:1070
who: Elio, a human man of forty, the granary master of the royal granary at the mountain-ring city: tall, about 181 cm, thin with a slight stoop from years of carrying sacks. Thin hair the colour of wheat straw, thick dark eyebrows pressed low over his eyes, gold eyes like newly threshed wheat that look first at what you are holding. A gaunt face with cheekbones standing out, thinner since the famine. Long fingers with ink on the tips from the ledger. A tireless, careful, exacting air. No glasses.
build: 181 cm, thin and tall, stooped a little at the shoulders, narrow shoulders and long arms, wiry strength.
palette: wheat straw and washed white, iron grey, ink black, gold
casual: A washed-out coarse wool coat gone white, the cuffs patched, over a plain linen shirt and dark trousers, worn boots. A leather cord around his neck holds an iron granary key as long as his hand. A ledger bound with hemp rope at his belt. He holds a pen in his right hand; a tired, careful look.
private: Off duty: a loose old linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a threadbare grey wool vest, soft old trousers and shoes, the iron key still on its cord at his chest. He hugs the ledger closed against his chest with both arms; a drained, absent look.
battle: Standing guard: the white-grey coat buttoned, a leather apron, sleeves tied back. He grips the iron key in his right fist like a weapon, feet planted, shoulders squared; he carries no sword. A hard, immovable look.
battle_pose: 3) the granary-guard outfit: squared and stubborn, the feet planted wide, the iron key gripped in the right fist held out in front of him and the hemp-bound ledger clutched in the left; he carries no sword.
formal: For the king's accounting: a clean dark wool coat with a soft folded collar, a fresh white linen shirt open at the neck, a neat grey sash, the long iron granary key polished and hung on its cord outside the coat, a faint silver rune cut into its bow, the ledger held in both hands. He stands straight, a formal, exact look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the gold eyes looking at the viewer as if checking what you carry, lips closed. Warm gold light from one side like lamplight on grain, cold grey light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting grain dust and the iron granary key swinging near the lens. He wears the washed-white coat.

name: 朵妮·长辙
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_一_崛起上.md:1126
who: Doni Longrut, a halfling carter of forty-six, the head of a grain-road cart train: small, about 112 cm, round and sturdy, a halfling with a youthful round face. A face reddened and polished by wind. Bright orange-red hair in two short braids, each tied at the tip with a little brass cart bell. Green eyes that squint into slits when she laughs and go perfectly round when she does sums. Broad, thick, calloused hands. A bright, bargaining, no-nonsense air.
build: 112 cm, small, round and sturdy, thick short hands.
palette: orange-red and brass, oilcloth olive, cream, grass green
casual: Her carter's smock: an oilcloth smock full of pockets, the pockets holding weights, tally slips and a handful of pine nuts, over a cream shirt, a long brown skirt and sturdy boots, a little steelyard hung at her belt. Two small brass bells on her braid tips. She holds a handful of pine nuts up like an offer, laughing; a warm, haggling grin.
private: Off the road: a soft long-sleeved cream wool dress buttoned to the collar under a knitted brown shawl, thick stockings and soft shoes, the braids loose with the bells still on. She holds a handful of pine nuts; a content, closed-mouth smile.
battle: Ready to hold the road: the oilcloth smock buttoned to the throat, leather gloves, sleeves tied back, boots laced tight. She grips a long cart whip in her right hand, the lash coiled over her shoulder, and braces the other fist on her hip; a stubborn, fierce look.
battle_pose: 3) the road-guard outfit: braced and stubborn, the feet planted wide, the long cart whip gripped in the right hand with the lash coiled, the left fist on her hip; she carries no sword.
formal: For signing the road: a clean cream blouse with a soft ribbon tie at the neck, a long dark green wool skirt, a brown wool jacket with a row of big brass toggles, the braids freshly plaited with the cart bells polished and humming faintly. She holds the little steelyard before her in both hands; a proud, businesslike smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait with the camera tilted, the green eyes laughing at the viewer, a bright haggling grin. Warm afternoon sun from one side, cool shade from the other. Foreground blur: a swinging brass bell and a few pine nuts. She wears the oilcloth smock with its many pockets.
face_extra: Only faint fine lines at the outer corners of the eyes show her age.

name: 露琪拉
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_一_崛起上.md:1182
who: Lucilla, a human girl of seventeen, an apprentice of the chronicle house: slender and light, about 160 cm, fully covered by her clothes. A mass of deep red curls with a copper writing pen always stuck in them at the back. A scatter of freckles, blue-green eyes that lean in close to everything as if to copy it. Ink all over her fingers and a writing callus on her right middle finger (on the viewer's left when they face us). No ring. An eager, sharp-eyed, scribbling air.
palette: deep red and ink black, academy grey, blue-green, paper cream
casual: Her chronicle apprentice's robe: a long grey linen robe, the sleeve cuffs tied with cord so they do not drag in the ink, closed to the throat, a small ink pot hung at the waist, a roll of blank pages under one arm, plain dark boots. The copper pen in the curls at the back of her head. An eager, close-looking expression.
private: Home clothes: a soft long-sleeved cream blouse buttoned to the collar under a loose grey wool house robe, a long plain skirt, soft shoes, the curls tied up with the pen through them. She holds a half-written page; a tired, concentrating look.
battle: Ready for the field: the grey robe belted tight over a dark long-sleeved tunic and trousers, leather bracers, boots laced. She holds the blank roll tight against her chest with the left arm and the copper pen up in her right hand like a dart; a sharp, determined look, the mouth shut.
battle_pose: 3) the chronicler's field outfit: upright and alert, the feet a little apart, the blank roll clutched to the chest in the left arm and the copper pen held up in the right hand; she carries no weapon.
formal: For the chronicle house's gathering: a clean grey linen robe with a white collar and tidy cord ties, the curls pinned back, the pen put in neatly, a small ink pot at the belt. She stands very straight with the roll held in both hands; a polite, serious look.
art: A close-up of the head and shoulders, the face leaning slightly toward the lens, the blue-green eyes wide open and looking closely at the viewer, lips closed. Warm lamp light from one side, cool grey dawn on the other. Foreground blur: a loose curl, the tip of a copper pen and a blank page. She wears the grey robe closed to the throat.

name: 达戈贝尔·灰须
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_一_崛起上.md:1483
who: Dagobert Greybeard, a human man of about thirty, a rider chief of the copper-wolf cavalry and grandson of the Greybeard duke: about 184 cm, wide-framed and heavy. A broad face with a full ruddy-brown beard. Dark amber eyes. He wears a whole copper-wolf pelt over his armour, the wolf's head worn as a helm, the fangs of Blackstone silver. A loud, proud, headlong air that charges first and never looks back. No glasses.
build: 184 cm, wide and heavy: thick shoulders, a barrel chest, heavy arms.
palette: copper-bronze, wolf-hide brown, Blackstone silver, dark amber
casual: A suit of copper-colored pressed hide plate armour with a whole copper-wolf pelt draped over the shoulders and back, the wolf's head with its Blackstone silver fangs resting on his shoulder like a hood, a belt hung with many small things including a thumb-sized wooden ring. A broad sword at his hip. He rests his hands on the belt; a proud, loud look.
private: Off duty: a loose brown wool shirt open at the throat, leather trousers, tall boots, the wolf pelt hung loosely from one shoulder. His thumbs are hooked in the belt beside the wooden ring; a confident, lazy grin.
battle: Charging dress: the copper-hide armour, the wolf-head helm pulled on with the silver fangs bared, the pelt streaming back from the shoulders, leather gauntlets. He grips a long broad sword in his right hand, held high, and a round shield on his left arm; a savage, shouting look.
formal: For the banners: the armour polished, a clean red-brown cloak over the pelt, the silver fangs of the helm polished, the helm under his arm. He stands tall, one hand on the sword hilt; a proud, imperious look.
art: A portrait with the camera low, the face large, the dark amber eyes looking at the viewer with proud, hard certainty, lips closed. Strong copper light from one side, cold grey from the other. Foreground blur: the blurred silver fangs of the wolf-head and drifting sparks. He wears the pelt over the armour.
